name: Skillry MCP
author: Yihui
description: Search, preview, and install curated creative Agent Skills (slides, websites, images, launch videos) directly inside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, and Claude Desktop.

localizations.name: Skillry MCP
localizations.description: 在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Gemini CLI 与 Claude Desktop 中直接搜索、预览并一键安装精选创意 Agent Skills（PPT、网站、图片、发布视频）。

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Describe the desired output, not an input format, and pass outputType when clear. Use deliveryScope to distinguish a complete video from a component; pass avoidVoiceover, allowApiKeys and allowExternalCosts from explicit user constraints. Clarify missing purpose/content, inspect requirementReview, dependencies and costNotice before recommending. Defaults to keyword retrieval; hybrid requires explicit service configuration. Supports locale and nextOffset pagination. Search does not grant access or guarantee execution; never silently substitute a selected Skill.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Inspect a Skill before installing: preview page, published version, inputs, dependencies, external cost notes and outputs. Metadata does not grant package access.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Check live membership using the browser-authorized local credential. Does not return tokens or personal identity.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Begin browser authorization only when the user asks to connect. Returns a verification link immediately. Show the link and matching code; call connection_status after pollAfterSeconds. Repeated calls reuse the pending flow.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Resume browser authorization without waiting in a tool call. Respect pollAfterSeconds. Reports pending, denied, expired or connected; never returns credentials.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: When the user asks to disconnect, cancel pending authorization, revoke the shared CLI/MCP credential and remove it from local credential storage. Reports whether server revocation succeeded.

tools.name: get_skill_access
tools.description: Check live access to one published Skill before downloading: free, member, purchased or purchase_required, correct purchase URL, daily quota and canDownload. Does not consume a download slot. Download rechecks all permissions.

tools.name: list_installed_skills
tools.description: List installed Skills in an explicitly selected global or project directory. Only Skillry-managed installs have a recorded version; other installs are marked unmanaged. Reads metadata and never executes code.

tools.name: check_updates
tools.description: Check current published metadata for Skillry-managed local installations. Does not download, upgrade or consume quota. Select a result and use update_skill with its publishedVersion only after user approval.

tools.name: update_skill
tools.description: Only after the user approves the selected published version, upgrade a Skillry-managed install. Requires expectedVersion from check_updates/get_skill. Preserves the entire old directory as a backup, including local edits. Does not execute the Skill.

tools.name: download_skill
tools.description: After user selection, download a verified published Skill ZIP to an explicit absolute downloadDirectory without installing or executing it. Checks live permissions and quota. Existing files are never overwritten.

tools.name: install_skill
tools.description: After user selection, download and install the current published Skill into the chosen local agent directory. Checks live entitlement and archive integrity. Does not execute the Skill or overwrite existing installs. Paid access failures include a purchase link.
